observations.error: TypeError: duplicate max_receipts keyword in test configuration construction
observations.repair: Merge default and explicit test options without duplicate keyword arguments. No product change.

observations.error: Actual backup refused because its 184320-byte snapshot exceeded the initial 65536-byte per-artifact test policy
observations.repair: Declare 262144-byte artifact cap, 65536-byte headroom and separate 1300000-byte logical-budget case before qualification. No product limit relaxed.

observations.outcome: Passed its original contract but superseded for sustained-operation qualification
observations.reason: A 2.7-second repeated-operation trial is too short to support a sustained-operation conclusion. Retain original JSON/HTML unchanged; require five seconds of live reader dwell in each cycle for the final contract.

observations.cause: Full status equality incorrectly required unchanged free bytes for the whole host filesystem; the free-space observation changed by 12288 bytes while owned state was unchanged.
observations.repair: Compare all owned status fields including logical/allocated bytes and hashes of every managed file/directory; exclude only shared statvfs filesystem_free_bytes. Apply the same correction to two request-refusal tests. Add a control showing global free-space drift is ignored but real managed file mutation is detected.

findings: Capacity observer accepted manifest corruption after a real service refusal in both modes because it compared only db.sqlite hashes and receipt count.
Copied reports with negative PID/FD/RSS/bytes or zero RSS passed the original numeric checker. Original actual values remain valid.
Old reboot token had stale epoch and revision together; new formal-service tests isolate each dimension.
observations.repair: Full owned-state witness and six real-service corruption controls; exact numeric type/range validation and report controls; independent reader authority fences. Product unchanged.

observations.reason: Profile name produced a 107-byte Lima temporary SSH socket path, over macOS limit 104
observations.cleanup: Original receipt records retained detached disk; formal Lima disk-delete then removed only the newly created empty owned disk. Separate sanitized cleanup receipt retained.
observations.repair: Preflight temporary socket path before VM creation; refuse too-long names with no side effects; after owned profile deletion, remove a remaining owned detached disk through Lima, without force or touching other names.
